items.question: Is billing enabled?
items.answer: No. These plans are commercial positioning labels for sales and demo conversations. Stripe, billing, checkout and invoices are not implemented.

items.question: Are plan limits enforced?
items.answer: No. Starter, Supplier Pro, Partner, Buyer Pilot and Buyer Pro are labels only in this version. They do not change product access or enforce limits.

items.question: Is Buyer Pro available now?
items.answer: No. Buyer Pro is a future/deferred buyer-side concept. This version does not include buyer accounts, buyer login or a buyer portal.

items.question: Is Supplier Passport a certification?
items.answer: No. Supplier Passport structures supplier-provided sustainability information and supporting evidence. It is not a certification, assurance report, or legal compliance opinion.
